usage_limit: Not run because the account hit its usage limit.
model_not_supported: Not run because that PC's default Codex model can't be used with the current sign-in (ChatGPT subscription). Enter a usable model in Settings → This PC (PC settings on the hub screen) → “Codex model for Ieon”.
account_limit_reached: The API account this AI staff member uses hit its set limit — to change the limit, go to Settings → Account on the Ieon screen (it won't be resent automatically)
service_needs_api_key: This bot serves people other than the owner, so it needs an API key account — add an [API key] for that PC/cell once in Settings → Account on the Ieon screen and it works right away (the owner can keep using it on the web)
session_in_use: Not sent because that session is in use elsewhere (app, terminal, or another run). Send it again when it's done.
session_load_failed: Not sent because that session couldn't be loaded (it won't be replaced with a new session). Check the session ID.
engine_not_installed: This engine's CLI isn't installed on that PC. Check the prerequisites in the manual.
work_dir_required: Not sent because work mode only works for conversations with a work folder. Add a work folder in Settings → This PC → Allowlist, or turn off work mode.
work_dir_missing: Not sent because this conversation's work folder doesn't exist on that PC.
account_not_logged_in: Not sent because the selected Ieon account isn't logged in. Log in at Settings → Account on the Ieon screen.
member_limit: You've used up today's question limit (set by the hub admin). You can send again at midnight Korea time.
combo_unverified: Not sent because continuing existing conversations through this compatible endpoint isn't verified yet. Use it in a new session, or choose another account in Settings → Account on the Ieon screen.
account_missing: Not sent because the selected Ieon account doesn't exist. Choose again in Settings → Account on the Ieon screen.
conversation_busy: Can't send because a question is already being processed in this conversation.
host_busy: Not sent because that PC/cell is handling several other questions — please send again in a moment (it won't be resent automatically)
device_unavailable: Can't send because the PC is disconnected. Check that the PC is on.
hub_mode: This PC is connected to a hub, so questions received here aren't processed. Send from the hub screen or a messenger bot connected to the hub.
desktop_holds_thread: Not sent because this conversation is open in the Codex app. Close it in the app and send again.
thread_busy: Not sent because this conversation is in use on the shared server.
thread_not_open: This conversation isn't open on the shared server.
shared_server_down: The shared App Server isn't running.
shared_server_not_configured: The shared App Server isn't set up.
session_not_running: The Claude session isn't running. Restart the session with the channel.
live_disabled: AI replies are off. Turn on the switch at the top of the Ieon screen.
session_archived: This session is archived. Restore it from the archive on the left, then ask.
active_limit: Too many new-session questions are being processed at once. Send again in a moment.
session_forked: The result can't be confirmed because the same Claude session is open in a terminal. It won't be resent automatically.
profile_not_allowed: This permission can't be chosen on the screen.
messenger.session_archived: This session is archived. Restore it with /restore <name>, then ask.
ns.new_sessions_disabled: New sessions are turned off (Settings → Admin → Register conversations)
ns.app_not_allowed: You can't create new sessions from this app
ns.bad_name: Names are 2–32 letters, digits, or - (starting and ending with a letter or digit)
ns.bad_engine: The engine must be one of codex, claude, antigravity, or grok
ns.profile_not_allowed: full permission can only be chosen when the hub admin turns on the full switch for new sessions in Settings → Admin → Register conversations on the Ieon screen
ns.unknown_host: That PC/cell isn't in the list
ns.name_taken: A session with the same name already exists
ns.session_limit: Session limit exceeded — archive or delete sessions you don't use
ns.engine_limit: Session limit for this engine exceeded
ns.conversation_busy: A question is being processed or needs review
ns.engine_not_allowed_for_role: This bot's role can't create that engine
ns.profile_not_allowed_for_role: This bot's role can't choose that permission
app.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet and the server address.
app.unauthorized: This device was disconnected. Create a new pairing code on the web screen and connect again.
app.bad_code: The pairing code is wrong, already used, or more than 10 minutes old. Create a new code on the web screen.
app.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in 1 minute.
app.session_changed: The result can't be confirmed (it won't be resent automatically). See the review card.
app.approval_closed: This approval was already decided or has expired.
app.hub_mode: This PC is connected to a hub, so questions sent here aren't processed. Connect with the hub address.
app.live_disabled: AI replies are off. Turn them on from the web screen.
app.session_archived: This session is archived. Restore it from the web screen, then ask.
voice_no_key: No OpenAI API key — add one in Settings → Accounts → OpenAI voice
voice_members_off: This hub has OpenAI voice turned off for members (the hub owner can turn it on in Settings)
voice_limit: You've used up today's OpenAI voice time (the daily max can be changed in Settings)
voice_mode_off: The voice method changed. Tap again.
voice_key_rejected: OpenAI didn't accept the API key — please check it
voice_key_unreachable: Couldn't reach OpenAI to check the key. Save again in a moment.
voice_openai_busy: Hit an OpenAI usage limit (check your OpenAI account's limits and balance)
voice_openai_failed: OpenAI voice failed. Try again in a moment.
voice_openai_unreachable: Couldn't reach OpenAI. Check your internet connection.
voice_bad_text: There's no text to read, or it's too long
voice_mic: Can't use the microphone. Allow the microphone in the device or browser settings.
voice_connect_failed: Couldn't connect to the OpenAI live conversation
bad_voice: The OpenAI voice settings aren't valid
bad_voice_model: The model name isn't valid (lowercase letters, digits and .-_ only)
bad_voice_limit: A time value is out of range
bad_voice_key: That doesn't look like an OpenAI API key (starts with sk-)
session_model_mismatch: Not sent: this session was made with another provider's model, so it can't continue with the current account (such as the PC sign-in). In Settings → Accounts → Claude accounts, choose a compatible-endpoint account that serves that model for this conversation.
